draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Route Chandigarh to Rudrapur
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Route Chandigarh to Rudrapur

Dear Apex Chemicals Team,

Please be advised that vehicle CH40IK6238 experienced a mechanical breakdown during transit.
A replacement vehicle, registration CH10YZ3615, has been dispatched from our Chandigarh hub to ensure continuity of service.
The new vehicle is currently en route to Rudrapur with an estimated arrival time of approximately 10.3 hours.
We apologize for the inconvenience and will continue to monitor the shipment closely.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
